name: Midian
overview: Midian is identified in Scripture as one of the sons of Abraham through Keturah, his concubine, highlighting the continuation of Abraham's lineage beyond Isaac. The genealogies recorded in Genesis 25 and 1 Chronicles 1 emphasize Midian's role as a patriarch, listing his descendants and affirming their place among the children of Keturah. This underscores God's faithfulness in expanding Abraham's family and promises through multiple lines, which ultimately contribute to the unfolding of His redemptive plan.
